text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia.

The ultrasound confirms a thickened endometrial stripe in a postmenopausal woman, which is highly suspicious for endometrial pathology, likely driven by the adnexal mass (potentially an estrogen-secreting ovarian tumor). While endometrial cancer is a critical concern, hyperplasia is the immediate structural diagnosis based on the endometrial thickness alone. Given the confirmed mass and bleeding, we must rule out malignancy; I will request an endometrial biopsy to assess for cellular atypia or carcinoma.
